text:
maya: follow-up on compaction tradeoffs: idea = adaptive compaction windows + write-amplification budget to avoid thrash when offloading/evicting
tony: tl;dr?
maya: instead of compact-on-write single-shot, maintain a sliding compaction window per-shard. window grows/shrinks based on recent hot-span stability and a tenant-level write-amplification budget.
frank: interesting. how do you measure "hot-span stability" cheaply?
maya: use a cheap decay counter per-range and a recent-stability score: stability = hits_in_last_T / hits_in_prev_T. sketch it with exponential buckets to avoid high memory.
sasha: write-amplification budget? what does that throttle exactly?
maya: budget is tokens-per-minute representing bytes we can safely relocate for a tenant. each compaction consumes budget proportional to bytes_copied * amplification_factor. budget replenishes slowly and can be tied to reserved throughput or billing tier.
ton y: spelling out modes: when window is small we only micro-compact very local spans; when stable and budget ok we expand to cluster bigger neighborhoods, reducing fragmentation long-term but paying cost now.
frank: eviction interplay? we could compact then evict immediately if pressure spikes
maya: two mitigations: 1) staged compaction only targets spans predicted to increase locality score above eviction threshold, and 2) compaction reserves a soft pin on target pages until publish or small timeout; eviction checks those pins and avoids them short-term. pins are soft and limited to prevent starvation.
sasha: atomicity/remap concerns?
maya: same descriptor+epoch publish we use elsewhere: copy -> publish descriptor swap -> free after epoch drain. journal a compaction intent so recovery can rollback incomplete ops.
ton y: metrics to add: compaction_window_size, write_amp_budget_remaining, stability_score_p50/p95, bytes_moved_per_window, compaction_pain_events (where compaction coincided with eviction).
frank: sounds complex to tune. rollout plan?
maya: opt-in flag for tenant, telemetry-only mode first where sampler & stability scores emit metrics but compaction disabled. next, experimental compaction with tiny default budgets for non-critical tenants. ramp and add adaptive knobs if we see thrash.
sasha: could we simulate effect in perf harness first? replay typical access traces and model budget rules before touching production.
maya: yes. I'll wire sampler+stability into the harness and run a few long traces.
infra-bot: created issue RUNTIME-5432: "adaptive compaction-window + write-amplification budget PoC" and linked thread. :robot_face:
tony: thanks. ping me when the harness runs exist and i'll help with the eviction-rule tests
maya: will do. thanks!
